uncited: The computation involves a fixed number of arithmetic operations and boundary checks.
Requires storage for 4 indices and a few temporary variables.
*   **When to use:** When implementing Marching Cubes or similar algorithms that require access to all cells sharing an edge.
*   **When not to use:** When only a single cell lookup is needed (use [Uniform Grid Indexing](6941-uniform-grid-indexing.md)).
It addresses the topological requirement of identifying all volumes surrounding an edge, which is necessary for constructing consistent surface meshes from voxel data.
